news.title: Full year 2026 earnings: EPS exceeds analyst expectations while revenues lag behind
news.body: Full year 2026 results: EPS: ₹24.07 (up from ₹22.28 in FY 2025). Revenue: ₹124.7b (up 3.3% from FY 2025). Net income: ₹17.1b (up 8.0% from FY 2025). Profit margin: 14% (in line with FY 2025). Revenue missed analyst estimates by 4.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) exceeded analyst estimates by 2.4%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.8% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 5.9% growth forecast for the Beverage industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 13% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 17% per year.

news.body: United Spirits Limited has approved the elevation of Mr. Amitabh Pande to the Executive Committee as Chief Strategy Officer (Senior Management Personnel) who will be reporting to Mr. Praveen Someshwar, Managing Director & Chief Executive Officer with effect from June 1, 2026. Mr. Amitabh Pande is a seasoned and accomplished professional with 27 years of experience, across consumer strategy, insights, marketing and business planning across multinational organisations. He has been with Diageo India since 2021 leading consumer planning, strategy and digital transformation. Prior to Diageo, he had senior leadership roles in organizations like IKEA and PepsiCo. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings: Revenues exceed analysts expectations while EPS lags behind
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.88 (up from ₹4.72 in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹36.9b (up 7.6% from 3Q 2025). Net income: ₹4.18b (up 25% from 3Q 2025). Profit margin: 11% (up from 9.8% in 3Q 2025). The increase in margin was driven by higher revenue. Revenue exceeded analyst estimates by 1.5%. Earnings per share (EPS) missed analyst estimates by 1.5%. Revenue is forecast to grow 9.3% p.a. on average during the next 3 years, compared to a 12% growth forecast for the Beverage industry in India. Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 12% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 20% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
